_doc: roll2f (two-story roll-up door) model deliverables; contract = r4-contract.md. Paths under 'source' are repo-relative, 'ship' is relative to MOD/.../42/. index = block * 64 + slot; spriteModels xy = index % 8, index // 8. Rebuild: README.md.
block_formula: block = (styleIdx * 4 + widthIdx) * 2 + faceIdx (global); integration splits per style (tiledef max 512 tiles per tileset, IsoWorld.java:639-640): tileset style_tileset, style_block = widthIdx * 2 + faceIdx, index = style_block * 64 + slot (fields per block)
placeholder_cell_dedupe: lane_mid is one file per style+face, used for every middle lane of every width
paint_note: painted style -> vanilla paint: its recipe takes one can of Base.Paint<paint> (2026-11-01)
model_space: Blender metres = tile units, Z up, one story = 2.44949. Origin = centre of lane tile 1 (the chain anchor, slot 0) on the floor; +X along the lanes (lane k centre x = k - 1); door line = tile edge y = +0.5; the drum housing sticks out to y = -0.10 on the camera side. Footprint x in [-0.5, L - 0.5], y in [-0.10, 0.5], z in [0, 4.889] (top of the 2nd story - 1 cm). Clear opening when open: width L - 0.2 between the rails, height 4.289 (housing bottom).

N._doc: Blender +X = PZ east, +Y = PZ north (door on the N edge of the lanes)

W._doc: Blender +X = PZ north, +Y = PZ west (door on the W edge; lane 1 = max y)

texture_note: one model per width; the model script texture is Industry, every spriteModels tile sets its style texture explicitly (same UV layout, IsoObjectModelDrawer binds spriteModel.textureName)

rig.SlatNN: curtain slat NN (0 = bottom, carries the bottom bar), 0.14 high; translation + rotation keys only (bone scale is ignored by AnimationPlayer)

clips.Open: closed -> open, 6.0 s (frames 1-145 @ 24 fps, keys every 2nd frame, times 0.042..6.042 s like the barrier arm); engine speedDelta 1.5 -> ~4.0 s. Curtain travel = TRAVEL * ease(t), ease (scripts/blender/ease.py): trapezoidal speed, 20 % accelerate / 20 % decelerate, baked into the keys (pose slots sample the clip at linear t = k/8 and get the eased pose)
clips.Close: exact reverse of Open, same length: travel = TRAVEL * ease(1 - t)

slots.1, 2: closed middle / last lane: no spriteModel, no 2D cell (transparent)
slots.9, 10: open middle / last lane: no spriteModel, no 2D cell
slots.16 .. 16+L-1: build-only placeholder for lane k = slot - 15: 2D cell = placeholder_cells
slots.48 .. 56: closing poses: same geometry as 32..40 (Open t = (slot-48)/8), same style texture

placeholder_cells_note: 128x256, lower story of the closed door sliced to the lane tile (upper story is not drawn in 2D; see assemble_roll2f.py docstring); lane_first / lane_mid / lane_last from the 3-wide model shared by all widths
